answer.reason: Noah's curse on Canaan is the one thing that happens to him in the verses, beyond the genealogy entries already in the summary.

clauses.english: was cursed by Noah to be a servant of servants to his brethren
clauses.quote: Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

doubts: GEN 28:1, 28:6, 28:8, 31:18 and 36:2 use Canaan for the land or its people, not the son of Ham, so I left them out.
The curse is spoken by Noah after Ham's deed; I took it as something that happened to Canaan.
